intro: Markham is one of the best places in Canada for Chinese food, from Hong Kong cafés to hand-pulled noodles, plus Unionville's charming Main Street. These are easy wins for a weeknight.

picks.name: Phoenix Restaurant
picks.why: Hong Kong-style café with an enormous menu — baked rice, milk tea and everything in between. Great when everyone wants something different.

picks.name: Congee Wong 天皇名粥
picks.why: Cantonese comfort food: silky congee, crispy noodles and fried dough for dunking. Fast, filling and affordable.

picks.name: Magic Noodles
picks.why: Hand-pulled noodles made to order in your choice of thickness. Lanzhou-style beef noodle soup is the move.

picks.name: Northern Dumpling Kitchen
picks.why: Northern Chinese dumplings — pan-fried or boiled — plus hearty noodle dishes.

picks.name: The Owl of Minerva
picks.why: Korean pork-bone soup (gamjatang) served bubbling hot. Open late, which makes it a classic late-night stop.

picks.name: Gyubee Japanese Grill
picks.why: All-you-can-eat Japanese-style tabletop grilling. Bring an appetite and a group.

picks.name: Jake's on Main
picks.why: Cozy pub on historic Main Street Unionville. Pair it with an evening stroll.
